items.title: Finite locally constant sheaves on a connected scheme are finite representations of the etale fundamental group
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies finite locally constant sheaves of Lambda-modules on a connected scheme with finite Lambda-modules carrying a continuous action of the etale fundamental group (statement lines 10117-10168, a long statement with two displayed categories). The proof constructs both directions: from a finite locally constant sheaf to the finite module of fibres with its continuous action, using that the sheaf is trivialised by a finite etale covering (proof lines 10170-10182), and back from a continuous action through the finite quotient realised by such a covering (proof lines 10182-10197). The non-formal content is the continuity of the action and the construction of the inverse. The claim is H2: two constructions, both written out.
